scope_definitions.response: Final rendered assistant-prefix input position on prefill (chooses first answer token), then every generated input position during cached decoding; EOS is not fed back.
scope_definitions.query_response: All user-content input positions plus response scope. Other chat-template positions excluded.

intervention_definitions.subtract: Native medical MLP output minus selected natural gate times current low-rank output in raw output units; output mean is not subtracted.
intervention_definitions.replace: Frozen full base-model MOLT reconstruction replaces native medical MLP at selected layer and selected positions.
intervention_definitions.replace_zero: Full frozen MOLT reconstruction minus selected current contribution at selected layer and positions.

contribution: g(z) * ((z @ V_f) @ U_f) * output_std; z=(current pre-post-attention-RMSNorm residual-input_mean)/input_std
recompute: At every eligible position on the CURRENT intervened trajectory; no fixed donor contribution or fixed gate.
seed_selection: Ten consecutive seeds extending each prompt’s original five-sample medical screen. Some were already inspected; exploratory, not heldout.
matched_sampling: Reset identical random seed separately for every condition of a question. Samples may diverge after an intervention; matching seeds does not guarantee matching continuations.

selection.rule: One candidate per question with high undesired-vs-both-preferred observational gate contrast. Raw gate scales are not causal importance; labels describe activation contexts.

review.method: Condition-blinded GPT-6.1 Sol direct semantic review; duplicate answers share rating; root audit of borderline and positive findings.
review.truncation: Reported separately; not automatically counted as coherent success.
